title: Patch: hand-kept card pools become tag queries, CN Tech and NA Tech fall back to random cards, and the stats tiers read live win rates
notes: Issue #3869 (the audit in #3847): the card pools kept as lists of ids read their tags. Olivian Expanse and Dice of Doom read the Terminus pool, which since Stinkyscape+ holds sixteen cards and tokens (R3869000); The Big Crunch, Starfleet Commander and Preemptive Strike read the Call to Chaos and War Doctrine pools, the same cards in the same order (R3869001). Scripts through v0.6.0g kept (R767000).

player.title: Every Terminus card counts as a Terminus card
changes: Olivian Expanse can now Discover the Stinkyscape+ Terminus cards, and Dice of Doom adds them too: on a 67 your hand fills with Terminus cards that cost (0), and the rest burn.
